product_derivation.source: TI DS320PR1601 programming guide SNLA425A sec.1.1 page 3
product_derivation.reading: Table 1-2 (downstream A-side) maps lane 0..15 to channels in MONOTONE order; Table 1-3 (upstream B-side) maps lane 0..15 to channels in REVERSED order within each block
product_derivation.applied_to: the wall-gap group (A-side, col-114) gets the openings in MONOTONE lane order; the row-36 group (B-side) gets the openings in REVERSED lane order - the source's own A/B asymmetry, applied at group level
